title: Understand Agent Trajectories
abstract: Inspect agent run trajectories across datasets and models. A step-icicle reveals the most-traveled paths, an outcome sankey traces entry actions through dominant tools to outcomes, and a virtualized table cross-filters with both. Real trajectories from Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and DeepSWE Kimi-K2 backed by DuckDB-WASM and AnyTable.

title: Analyze Data with Agents
abstract: Monitor and interact with a parallel-agent system that explores datasets through coordinated sensemaking loops. Upload a CSV, watch threads investigate questions via SQL and LLM calls, and respond to stuck agents.

title: AnyTable
abstract: A headless, virtualized React table for large datasets. DuckDB-WASM powers in-browser querying with Mosaic coordination, so tables stay visualization-friendly and composable without a monolithic config surface.

title: Interpret Language Model Activations
abstract: Interpretability of activations in SmolLM3-3B. Explore attention, contribution, hidden state, MLP metrics, and layer norms through heatmaps. Select prompts, switch metrics, and inspect token- and layer-level details to understand how the model processes text.

title: Navigate the Gaia Star Catalog
abstract: Visualization of over 1 million stars from ESA's Gaia mission. Brush regions on the sky map to explore star clusters, view distributions of magnitude and parallax, and hover to see detailed information with links to SIMBAD and Gaia@AIP.

title: Visualize ML Traces from SWE-Bench
abstract: An interactive visualization of trace data from ML agents using OpenTelemetry, revealing performance patterns and the ReAct reasoning framework. Explore the traces and detailed spans to understand how agents think and act.

title: Explore Astronomy Concepts
abstract: Custom visualization that renders hierarchical datasets as elegantly-arranged circular nodes in a radial layout. Explore the Unified Astronomy Thesaurus with this custom-designed visualization featuring packed circles, collision resolution, and navigation.

title: Understand Embeddings Through Epic Fantasy
abstract: A journey through the world of embeddings, illustrated with epic fantasy literature and interactive visualizations. Learn how embeddings transform text into numerical vectors that capture meaning and relationships, using examples from The Wheel of Time, Mistborn, and other fantasy series.

title: Vistrates: A Versatile Tool for Data Analytics in the World of On-Device Intelligence
abstract: Introducing a platform for many activities in data exploration between multiple users on heterogeneous devices. Vistrates is web-based and collaborative by nature, thus supporting data analysis anywhere, anytime, and by anyone.

title: Elastic Documents: Reading Data-Rich Documents with Generated Visualizations
abstract: Linking text and tables through contextual visualizations in data-rich documents improves reading comprehension. Our user evaluations have shown the power of this new approach in summarization and comprehension of data-rich documents.
name: elasticdocs

title: Using Smartwatches and Large Displays Together for Data Analysis
abstract: New conceptual framework developed at University of Maryland and Technische Universität Dresden helps utilize multiple devices together for visual data analysis.
name: DG

title: TimeFork: Exploring Multiple Futures in the Stock Market with Generative Models
abstract: A new tool called TimeFork uses interactive graphics and state-of-the-art statistical models to allow traders to investigate multiple parallel universes for predicting the stock market.
